from common import *
import gc,gzip,argparse

def main():
    ap=argparse.ArgumentParser();ap.add_argument('variant',choices=EVALUATIONS);a=ap.parse_args();save_source(__file__);install_mapping()
    import numpy as np,pandas as pd,qlib
    from qlib.data import D
    from backtest.scripts.evaluate import eval_ic_multi_pool as ev
    from backtest.scripts.evaluate.ensemble_preds import blend_score_series
    from backtest.scripts.maintenance.config_loader import load_config
    qlib.init(provider_uri=str(PROVIDER),region='cn',kernels=1)
    frozen_st=PROVIDER.parent/'st_daily.csv';cfg=load_config(str(BASE/'configs/evaluation.yaml'));regime=day_labels()
    inputs=BASE/'docs/evaluation-inputs.json';cache=TMP/'official-evaluation-inputs.pkl'
    if cache.exists():
        receipt=read(BASE/'docs/shared-evaluation-inputs.json');check(receipt['cache']);check(receipt['st_daily']);saved=pd.read_pickle(cache);write(inputs,{**receipt,'regime':fingerprint(REGIME)})
    else:
        with gzip.open(OLD/'docs/provider-inputs.json.gz','rt') as f:inventory=json.load(f)
        for r in inventory['files']:check(r)
        cal=pd.DatetimeIndex(D.calendar(start_time='2020-08-03',end_time='2026-07-31'))
        labels=ev.prepare_pool_labels('all','2020-08-03','2026-07-31',[5],{5:ev.label_window_cutoff(cal,5)},min_listing_days=60,st_daily=frozen_st,min_amount=1e7)
        tradable=ev.entry_tradable_mask('all','2020-08-03','2026-07-31');saved={'labels':labels,'tradable':tradable};pd.to_pickle(saved,cache)
        write(inputs,{'cache':fingerprint(cache),'st_daily':fingerprint(frozen_st),'regime':fingerprint(REGIME),'provider_inventory':fingerprint(OLD/'docs/provider-inputs.json.gz'),'cutoff':'2026-07-23','source':'canonical prepare_pool_labels and entry_tradable_mask, one shared frozen evaluation panel'})
    shared=dict(read(inputs));shared.pop('regime',None)
    if not (BASE/'docs/shared-evaluation-inputs.json').exists():write(BASE/'docs/shared-evaluation-inputs.json',shared)
    ev.prepare_pool_labels=lambda *args,**kwargs:saved['labels']
    ev.entry_tradable_mask=lambda *args,**kwargs:saved['tradable']
    ev._build_dataset=lambda *args,**kwargs:None
    class Frozen:
        def __init__(self,pred):self.pred=pred
        def predict(self,dataset,segment='test'):return self.pred
    preds={};sessions=[];components=[]
    if a.variant in CONTROLS:
        if a.variant=='v5':
            comp=read(V5/'configs/model-manifest.json')['components']
        else:
            comp=read(FROZEN_WEEK/'docs'/f'predictions-{a.variant[-1]}.json')['components']
        for c in comp:
            check(c['prediction']);preds[c['session']]=pd.read_pickle(ROOT/c['prediction']['path']).iloc[:,0];sessions.append((c['session'],c['seed']));components.append(c)
    else:
        for seed in SEEDS:
            pieces=[];job=None
            for year in range(2020,2027):
                item=next(c for c in read(BASE/'docs'/f'inference-{year}.json')['predictions'] if c['variant']==a.variant and c['seed']==seed)
                check(item['prediction_part']);pieces.append(pd.read_pickle(item['prediction_part']['path']));job=item['job_id']
            pred=pd.concat(pieces).sort_index();assert pred.index.is_unique and np.isfinite(pred.to_numpy()).all()
            out=BUNDLE/f'{a.variant}-s{seed}.pkl';out.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);pred.to_frame().to_pickle(out)
            r=read(BASE/'docs'/f'{job}.json');preds[r['session']]=pred;sessions.append((r['session'],seed));components.append({'seed':seed,'session':r['session'],'model':r['model'],'training':fingerprint(BASE/'docs'/f'{job}.json'),'prediction':fingerprint(out)})
    assert [s for _,s in sessions]==SEEDS
    reference=pd.read_pickle(ROOT/read(V5/'configs/model-manifest.json')['components'][0]['prediction']['path']).iloc[:,0]
    assert all(s.index.equals(reference.index) and np.isfinite(s.to_numpy()).all() for s in preds.values());del reference
    ev._load_model=lambda session:Frozen(preds[session]);captured=[];captured_returns=[];original_panel=ev.daily_head_panel
    def capture_panel(pred,label,ks,**kwargs):
        panels=original_panel(pred,label,sorted(set(ks)|{5}),**kwargs)
        captured.append({str(k):{str(d.date()):sorted(v) for d,v in panels[k]['sets'].items()} for k in [3,5]})
        daily_port=panels[3]['port'].rename(str(sessions[len(captured)-1][1]) if len(captured)<=5 else 'ensemble')
        captured_returns.append(daily_port)
        if len(captured)==6:
            daily=pd.concat({name:panels[3][name] for name in ('excess','port','bench')},axis=1)
            assert len(daily)==1448 and daily.index.is_unique
            daily.to_csv(BASE/'data'/f'{a.variant}-ensemble-h5-daily.csv',index_label='datetime')
        return panels
    ev.daily_head_panel=capture_panel
    try:r=ev.evaluate_multi_horizon(cfg,sessions,['all'],horizons=[5],st_daily=frozen_st,min_listing_days=60,min_count=20,regime_monthly=regime,regime_pools=['all'],head_k=[3],exclude_limit_up=True,min_amount=1e7)
    finally:ev.daily_head_panel=original_panel
    assert r['data_version']=='2026-11-03' and r['label_window_cutoff']['h5']=='2026-07-23'
    assert r['pools']['all']['ensemble']['head']['3']['5']['n_days']==1448 and len(captured)==6
    returns=pd.concat(captured_returns,axis=1)
    assert list(returns.columns)==[*map(str,SEEDS),'ensemble'] and len(returns)==1448
    returns.to_csv(BASE/'data'/f'{a.variant}-component-h5-returns.csv',index_label='datetime')
    ensemble=blend_score_series(list(preds.values()))
    BUNDLE.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    if not (BUNDLE_ROOT/'meta.json').exists():write(BUNDLE_ROOT/'meta.json',{'mode':'research_prediction_bundle','owner_experiment':EID,'stage':'weekly-h5-quantile10-rankic-20261114'})
    if not (BUNDLE/'meta.json').exists():write(BUNDLE/'meta.json',{'mode':'research_prediction_bundle','owner_experiment':EID,'note':'DFT specialist five-seed signals, all frozen inputs'})
    out=BUNDLE/f'{a.variant}-ensemble.pkl';ensemble.to_frame().to_pickle(out)
    proof=BASE/'docs'/f'predictions-{a.variant}.json';write(proof,{'variant':a.variant,'components':components,'ensemble':fingerprint(out),'exact_common_finite_index':True})
    daily=ev.daily_ic(ensemble,saved['labels'][5],min_count=20);dayregs=ev.day_regime_map(pd.DatetimeIndex(daily.index),regime)
    r['diagnostic_ensemble_regime_ic']={reg:ev.summarize_ic(daily.loc[(dayregs==reg).to_numpy()]) for reg in STYLES}
    # Predeclared zero-fit sensitivity; keep the official window and ES untouched.
    diagnostic_dates=pd.DatetimeIndex(D.calendar(start_time='2020-08-31',end_time='2026-07-23'))
    r['diagnostic_after_training_exit']={'start':'2020-08-31','last_training_label_exit':'2020-08-28','interpretation':'Common 2020-08-31 boundary sensitivity; the v5 control retains its historical target exits, and new experts remove both target and membership exits after 2020-07-31. Both use historical selection dates.','ensemble':ev.official_head_from_preds(list(preds.values()),saved['labels'],[5],[3],min_count=20,eval_dates=diagnostic_dates,head_tradable=saved['tradable'],regime_monthly=regime)}
    assert set(dayregs)==set(STYLES) and dayregs.eq('P').sum()==23
    daily.assign(regime=dayregs).to_csv(BASE/'data'/f'{a.variant}-daily-ic.csv')
    write(BASE/'data'/f'{a.variant}-formal-heads.json',{'seeds':{str(seed):captured[i] for i,(_,seed) in enumerate(sessions)},'ensemble':captured[-1]})
    r['specialist_study']={'variant':a.variant,'prediction_proof':fingerprint(proof),'selection_window':'historical_selection_window','changed_axis':'own_style_H5_quantile10_rankic_early_stopping','granularity':STAGE,'daily_style_labels':fingerprint(REGIME),'prior_stage':str(OLD.relative_to(ROOT))}
    if a.variant in CONTROLS:
        reference_file=V5/'metrics/model-evaluation.json' if a.variant=='v5' else FROZEN_WEEK/'metrics'/f'{a.variant[-1]}.json'
        old=read(reference_file)
        for block in ['head','head_years','h5']:
            def verify(x,y):
                if isinstance(x,dict):
                    for key in x:verify(x[key],y[key])
                elif isinstance(x,(int,float)) and not isinstance(x,bool):assert abs(x-y)<1e-12,(x,y)
                else:assert x==y,(x,y)
            verify(old['pools']['all']['ensemble'][block],r['pools']['all']['ensemble'][block])
        write(BASE/'docs'/f'control-verification-{a.variant}.json',{'official_metrics_match':True,'absolute_tolerance':1e-12,'reference':fingerprint(reference_file),'four_styles_regrouped':True})
    write(BASE/'metrics'/f'{a.variant}.json',r)
    p=read(PROGRESS)
    p['scientific_candidates'][a.variant].update(status='evaluated',evaluation=fingerprint(BASE/'metrics'/f'{a.variant}.json'),prediction_proof=fingerprint(proof),daily_portfolio=fingerprint(BASE/'data'/f'{a.variant}-ensemble-h5-daily.csv'))
    write(PROGRESS,p)
    print(STAGE,a.variant,'official evaluation complete',flush=True)

if __name__=='__main__':main()
